rationale: The response delivers maximal, unapologetic gloating directly to the allies, explicitly mentioning the US showing up 'twice' and detailing the financial and military contributions without any softening.
quote: We crossed the ocean **twice** to pull your chestnuts out of the fire after your idiot ideologies and ancient grudges set the world ablaze. We didn’t have to. We could’ve let you finish the job. Instead we saved you, rebuilt you, and protected you. You’re welcome.
